story:
It was a beautiful sunny day at Oakdale Elementary School. Soomin was sitting in his classroom, excited for lunchtime, when he suddenly remembered something very important – his brand-new lunchbox! He had received it as a gift from his grandma just yesterday, and it was the most colorful box ever – blue with yellow birds flying all around.

But to Soomin's surprise, his lunchbox was nowhere to be found. "Oh no!" he cried out loud. His friends looked at him curiously. Mrs. Thompson, their kind teacher, approached Soomin and asked, "What's wrong, dear?"

"My new lunchbox is missing!" Soomin exclaimed.

Mrs. Thompson smiled and said, "Don't worry, we'll find it together." She suggested that they search the classroom first. Emma, a friendly classmate of Soomin, offered to help him look around. They searched high and low – under the desks, on top of the shelves, even in the pencil case – but there was no sign of Soomin's lunchbox.

Just then, the classroom pet, a cute hamster named Whiskers, scurried out from her cage and started to sniff around. Emma suggested that they ask Whiskers if she had seen anything. Whiskers squeaked loudly as if saying "I don't know!" But Soomin was not discouraged.

As they continued their search, they met Olivia, another classmate who loved puzzles. She joined the group and said, "Let's make a list of places we've looked so far. Maybe we'll find a clue." Together, they scribbled down all the spots they had searched – under the tables, on top of the lockers... But still no lunchbox.

Just when everyone was about to give up hope, Olivia suddenly remembered something. "Wait! I saw someone putting a blue box in the lost and found yesterday!" Soomin's eyes widened with excitement. Mrs. Thompson encouraged them all to go to the lost and found together.

When they arrived at the lost and found, what did they find? Soomin's lunchbox was sitting right on top – exactly as he had left it! Overjoyed, Soomin hugged his friends and said, "Thank you so much for helping me!"

Mrs. Thompson smiled proudly and said, "You all worked together and solved a mystery! That takes teamwork and kindness." Emma added, "And we even got to help our friend find something important!" Whiskers squeaked in agreement.

As they sat down to eat their lunch, Soomin looked at his friends with gratitude. He realized that helping others was one of the most wonderful things he could do. And so did his friends. From that day on, whenever someone needed help, the whole class would come together to lend a hand – or even just listen and offer words of encouragement.
